text_block_list.text:
After thinking about my goals for this
year, I
made a card for you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин hands me a New Year's
card.
Inside are her best wishes for the
year, as well as
a printed goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes, I am in my classic year now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume, I long to win the
Triple Crown
races...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
And as a stayer, the Kikuka Sho is the
one race
above all others that I don't
want to lose.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I win the Kikuka Sho, victory
in the
spring Tenno Sho will be within
reach!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: We'll win the Kikuka Sho for sure!

text_block_list.text: Yes, we shall attain this goal together!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Now since that has been decided, I
would like to
begin training posthaste,
however...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list:
Let's build a solid foundation for your
endurance.

text_block_list.text:
In other words, we should maintain the
pace
we've set and proceed forward with
diligence.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You're suggesting nutritional
supplementation,
then? I understand.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This time of year, the cafeteria will be
full of New
Year's dishes.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you're suggesting we deepen our

knowledge concerning the sites where
the
Classics take place?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
In that case, you can count on me. I will
follow
through properly, as I always do.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's essential to have a strategy for each
track in
order to win. I shall study them
carefully.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I may have trouble choosing what
to eat.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
